<a id="myapp-job-duration-note-2"></a>**[2] `myapp.job.id`:**

**Requirement level:** When the scheduler assigns an identifier to the job.

**Note:** The identifier is assigned by the scheduler and stays the same across retries of the same job.

<a id="myapp-job-duration-note-3"></a>**[3] `myapp.job.attempt`:** Instrumentations that cannot see retries done by the scheduler report 1 for every attempt.
